tracks.title: today is my favorite
tracks.excerpt: An album-length EP by the 20-year-old producer is a dizzying and boundless collage of collages, using free-jazz logic and digital overload to chart new emotional terrain.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位20岁的制片人制作了一张专辑长度的EP ，这是一张令人眼花缭乱的无限拼贴画，使用自由爵士逻辑和数字过载来绘制新的情感地形。

tracks.title: School's Out!
tracks.excerpt: The irreverent duo of Leo Fincham and Rowan Please plies its brilliantly digitized indie-pop bricolage on an album with the ragtag splendor of a low-budget musical.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 不敬的Leo Fincham和Rowan Please二人组合将其精彩的数字化独立流行拼凑在一张专辑中，并伴随着低成本音乐剧的破烂辉煌。

tracks.title: Psychic Video
tracks.excerpt: The UK selector throws caution—and genre—to the winds on an audacious 82-minute set that careens between ambient, drill’n’bass, post-punk, breakcore, and more.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 英国选择器在一个大胆的82分钟集合中对风投以谨慎和流派，该集合在环境， drill 'n 'bass ， post-punk ， breakcore等之间进行调整。

tracks.title: This is How it Should Be Done
tracks.excerpt: For their collaborative full-length debut, Eris Drew and Octo Octa hunkered down in their New Hampshire cabin to craft a celebratory, sample-heavy tribute to the maximalist dance music of yore.
tracks.excerpt_zh: Eris Drew和Octo Octa在他们的新罕布什尔州小木屋里蹲下，为他们合作的全长首演制作了一个庆祝性的样品，向昔日的极致舞曲致敬。

tracks.title: It Ain’t Me Babe
Low Times
tracks.excerpt: On his second album as Ghost Dubs , German producer Michae Fiedler pares his beats and grooves further back, reducing his already minimal palette to the stark rhythmic and textural fundamentals. But the tracks on Oblique resist the remoteness of some ambient dub — they might be skeletal, but they’re not bare-bones. The post Ghost Dubs :: Oblique first appeared on Aquarium Drunkard .
tracks.excerpt_zh: 在他作为Ghost Dubs的第二张专辑中，德国制片人Michae Fiedler进一步削减了他的节奏和凹槽，将他本已微不足道的调色板减少到严酷的节奏和纹理基础。但是斜线上的轨道抵抗了一些环境配音的偏僻—它们可能是骨骼的，但它们不是赤裸裸的。帖子Ghost Dubs:: Oblique首次出现在Aquarium Drunkard。

tracks.title: The thing
tracks.excerpt: The Danish artist achieves a beguiling flow state on her second solo album: a set of future standards full of empty space.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位丹麦艺术家在她的第二张个人专辑中实现了一种迷人的流动状态：一套充满空旷空间的未来标准。

tracks.excerpt: Like the best giallo scores, Surprise Chef's Frogs In A Pond finds beauty in the uneasy marriage of the sinister and the seductive. Its analog warmth and locked-in grooves evoke a bygone era without becoming trapped in it, blurring the line between recordings from 2026 and 1976.
